title: The Interesting book about the sea
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：interesting　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 interesting 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the keeper wrote of ① an interesting book about the sea in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more interesting than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the interesting ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most interesting book about the sea anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too interesting to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the interesting ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an interesting question from the pupil, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as interesting as the question from the pupil they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was interesting or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something interesting, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite interesting; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the interesting ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, on the same day, she wrote of another interesting book about the sea in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more interesting than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most interesting question from the pupil in the whole tower, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the interesting ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有趣（前置定语 an interesting book about the sea：1964 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件有趣的书）
B. adj. 有趣／引人入胜（比较级 more interesting than：文中两处，一处比讲大海的有趣的书，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有趣／引人入胜（最高级 the most interesting：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有趣（表语 too interesting to do：母亲觉得它太有趣，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 引人入胜（前置定语 an interesting question from the pupil：叔叔把整件事称作一桩引人入胜的有趣问题）
F. adj. 引人入胜（同级比较 as interesting as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学生提出的有趣问题相比）
G. adj. 引人入胜（后置定语 something interesting：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 引人入胜（受程度副词修饰 quite interesting：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: an interesting book about the sea
the most interesting book about the sea anybody
an interesting question from the pupil
The most interesting question from the pupil in

answers.why: interesting 意为“有趣”，1964 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件有趣的书”，此处作前置定语 an interesting book about the sea。
interesting 意为“有趣”，此处用比较级 more interesting than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
interesting 意为“有趣”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最有趣的一件，故用最高级 the most interesting book about the sea。
interesting 意为“有趣”，母亲认为这件东西“太有趣了，谁也用不上”，too interesting to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
interesting 意为“引人入胜”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩引人入胜的有趣问题”，此处作前置定语 an interesting question from the pupil。
interesting 意为“引人入胜”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学生提出的有趣问题一样引人入胜”，同级比较用 as interesting as。
interesting 意为“引人入胜”，年历上那半行字要的是“引人入胜的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something interesting。
interesting 意为“引人入胜”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当引人入胜”，quite 修饰原级 interesting。
interesting 意为“引人入胜”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要引人入胜”，故用比较级 more interesting than。
interesting 意为“引人入胜”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个钟楼里最引人入胜的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most interesting question from the pupil。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件有趣的书。（an interesting book about the sea）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有趣。（more interesting than …）
母亲觉得它太有趣，谁也用不上。（too interesting to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩引人入胜的有趣问题。（an interesting question from the pupil）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学生提出的有趣问题一样引人入胜。（as interesting as …）
到了 1971 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件引人入胜的东西。（something interesting）
answers: In 1964 the keeper wrote of an interesting book about the sea in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more interesting than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too interesting to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an interesting question from the pupil.
He said nobody would call it as interesting as the question from the pupil they had once had.
By 1971 the calendar asked for nothing but something interesting.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 interesting 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the keeper wrote of an interesting book about the sea in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most interesting book about the sea in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too interesting to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an interesting question from the pupil, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite interesting, and everybody laughed.
The interesting ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
